grammar.title: 比较级与最高级
grammar.explanation: 比较级用于两者比较，最高级用于三者及以上。比较级前可用much, far, a lot, even, still等修饰；最高级前通常加the。
grammar.structure: more + 多音节形容词; 形容词-er + than; the + 最高级

examples.sentence: Urban residents face significantly more pressure than rural dwellers.
examples.translation: 城市居民面临比农村居民大得多的压力。

examples.sentence: This is the most challenging task I have ever undertaken.
examples.translation: 这是我承担过的最具挑战性的任务。

grammar.ieltsTip: 雅思写作Task 1比较数据时，比较级是核心工具，注意修饰词的使用以体现精确度。

speaking.topic: Describe a skill you want to learn
speaking.cueCard: Describe a skill you would like to learn. You should say: what the skill is / why you want to learn it / how you would learn it / and explain how this skill would benefit you.
speaking.sampleAnswer: A skill I've been eager to acquire is sign language. I became interested in it after watching a documentary about the deaf community, which opened my eyes to the barriers they face in daily communication. To learn it, I plan to enroll in online courses offered by reputable institutions and practice regularly with members of the deaf community through language exchange programs. Mastering sign language would benefit me in multiple ways: professionally, it would allow me to work more inclusively as an educator; personally, it would enable me to connect with a community that is often marginalized. Moreover, learning sign language would give me a deeper appreciation for the diversity of human communication and challenge my assumptions about how language works. Ultimately, I believe this skill would make me not only a more effective communicator but also a more empathetic person.
speaking.tips: 描述未来计划时使用 would/will，注意条件句的运用。
